svg.text: IVCU-EV V3 — from 42 sensors to the top level
Every box is a real module instance. Cell counts and areas from synth_full_20260804_160929.log. Standard-cell total 633,274 um2 + 572,456 um2 of SRAM macro.

g.text: analog path — the only one that works
in-delay 35 ns of a 100 ns period
por_n is the true master reset
PMIC status flags. Real VDD is metal.

on clk_aon — must survive AI power-down
24,719 um2 · cruise, lane keep, auto brake
its 3 outputs have no top-level port
NOT ONE OUTPUT IS CONNECTED — see 1
rd_en tied 0 — the log is never read

svg.text: what the chip exists to do
carry 2 bits of mode. That is all.
WHAT THE DIAGRAM SHOWS THAT THE CODE DOES NOT SAY OUT LOUD
u_diagnostic is the 3rd largest module, 18.8% of
your standard-cell area. Read its instantiation:
12 inputs, 3 tie-offs, and not one output port.
the same bug, a second time
parameter. The constant never reaches the module,
Identical to the bug that cost 575,000 um2.
sensor_data[] is written on clk_sensor and read on
clk_ai, clk_aon and clk_mcu with no sync_cell —
including the path into the safety FSM.
The 2-bit mode signal IS synchronised. Odd.
Channels 0–11 arrive analog through the ADC.
Channels 12–41 arrive already digital and bypass
it. The ADC source says so in a comment:
